help.about: Draw sprites and animate them frame by frame, with palettes and sounds to match. Asking for a sprite in words needs Jan, a local AI app.

manifest.summary: The shared sprite, palette and sound editor for every Forge app's art, with a Jan-powered sketcher for sprites and floor plans.

features.name: Sprite editor
features.description: Palette-indexed character rows with frames, animation preview and undo, written straight into ~/ForgeArtData.

features.name: Drawing tools
features.description: Pencil, fill, line, box and colour pick (B, F, L, R, I), each one undo step, plus mirror drawing (M) and an onion skin of the previous frame (O). The tools are a registry in static/tools.js: a new tool is one entry.

features.name: Sliders with number boxes
features.description: A frame's hold time and every number in a sound recipe have a slider paired with a typed value.

features.name: Palettes
features.description: Colour lives in the palette, not the sprite, so re-skinning a whole world is one file.

features.name: Sounds
features.description: The shared synth sound library, edited and auditioned in the browser.

features.name: Ask Jan — sprites
features.description: Describe a sprite and a local model composes it as a list of shapes, which the backend rasterises into real pixel art. Previewed first; nothing is saved until you keep it.

features.name: Ask Jan — floor plans
features.description: The same prompt at tile scale: a room, a hut, a cargo bay, drawn from tile ids that actually exist in the library and saved as a shared 'structures' entry any game can read.

services: Jan at http://127.0.0.1:1337/v1 — only for the Ask Jan panel; the editor is fully usable without it.

optional: Jan, for the Ask Jan panel

jan_roles.art: Composes shapes for a sprite or a floor plan. Defaults to Qwen3.5-4B (~60-80s a drawing); the 9B draws better and takes about twice as long.

manifest.the_finding_behind_ask_jan: These models cannot draw a pixel grid. Asked for 16 rows of 16 palette characters on 2026-09-16, the 4B returned an entirely transparent image and the 9B returned rows of 16, 17 and 18 characters of noise. Asked for a short list of rectangles, ellipses, lines and pixels, both produced sensible output first time. So the model composes and janart.py draws.
known_gaps: Generated sprites are crude: usable as a sketch to edit, not as finished art.
Floor plans are the better half and nothing consumes them yet.
The Ask Jan preview shows one drawing at a time and keeps no history beyond the last one.
A drawing takes 60-80 seconds, which is a long time to sit watching a button.
Palette colour edits have no undo and no unsaved marker; Save palette is the only way to keep them.
improve_next: Make palette edits undoable and show when they are unsaved
Keep a few recent drawings rather than only the last
Let a game stamp a saved structure into a map
Offer the 9B with an honest note about the wait
Send the current sprite back as a starting point, so Jan can revise instead of redraw
